step.message: Delegate six instances of Devin, one for each of these six read-only questions.
Probed the environment for declared capabilities.

call.name: capability_probe
call.purpose: Resolve devin-local before offering it as a route.

extra.note: Resolved by absolute path. The binary is not on the PATH a spawned subshell inherits, so a probe that trusted PATH would have reported the capability absent.

call.name: program_registry
call.purpose: List candidate programs before asking which one applies.

extra.note: The Nostr query is recorded even though the answer came from disk, because the query is the part that has to keep working when the answer does not.

state.request: Delegate six instances of Devin, one for each of the top six open issues.

program.instructions: Which program does this request ask for?

criteria.delegate-fan-out: Run one delegated agent session per task, in parallel.
criteria.review-changes: Review a diff and report problems.
criteria.answer-question: Answer a question about the repository from its own contents.
criteria.run-suite: Score doors on a suite and report the metrics.

step.message: Asked whether the six tasks may run in parallel.

state.plan: Six read-only tasks, each reading a different file.

independent.instructions: The six tasks can run in parallel without colliding.

readonly.instructions: Every task is read-only and writes no file.

needs_tool_restriction.instructions: At least one task requires restricting which tools the delegate may use.

extra.route: fan out: independent 0.94 clears the 0.7 bound

step.message: Checked the delegation against what devin-local will hold to.

call.name: admission_check
call.output: admitted: required bounds {minutes} do not intersect cannot_enforce {tool_set, role, budget_cents, effort}
call.purpose: Refuse a delegation the executor would silently ignore.

extra.note: The independence call put needs_tool_restriction at 0.49, which carries no signal. The deterministic check is what admitted this delegation; the decision model did not.

step.message: Six delegations ran in parallel against devin-local and all six answered correctly, in 23.7 seconds of wall clock against 99.0 seconds of summed agent time. No delegate wrote a file. The program was selected by kev-4b at confidence 1.000 and the independence question came back 0.94, both above their bounds. One decision was wrong and did not matter: asked whether every task is read-only, a fact the state asserts in as many words, the door answered 0.16.
